role: Tape setup for server-replay lanes, run just before Snapshot: turns doMobSpawning off (unless mobs:true), removes every non-player entity on server and client, stops chunk generation on provide and empties the unload queue, preloads a (2r+1)^2 chunk square around the player, and zeroes Rows.blkCount; optional rain/thunder/generateNether/generateEnd keys.
used_by: {"cmd":"run","class":"MobFree"} in oracle/tests/*.jsonl (mobfree-*, pickaxemf*, pickwalk, scen-*, fight-*, end-dragon-s1, ...)
notes: Accepted as a legacy setup entry in old non-dev tapes (Oracle.legacySetup).
